repositoryTask.title: Multi-currency quoting: extend the pricing contract
repositoryTask.instruction: Extend the shared quote contract with a currency field and rounding rules: USD/EUR keep two decimal places, zero-decimal currencies such as JPY are priced and rendered as integers.
repositoryTask.acceptance: Quote contract carries currency and rounding rules; existing USD behavior unchanged; repository test command passes.

advisoryContext.discoveryEvidence: pricing-core is the shared contract producer; billing and checkout consume its quote schema.
advisoryContext.decompositionHint: Contract change and rounding implementation are separable steps.
